main_text.p: 4. Quædam etiam assumunt υ: ut ῥέω ῥύῶ fluo, am, ab Æolico ῥύῶ: at ῥυέω idem significans, ῥύω.
χέω χύῶ, fundo, am. sic πλέω navigo.
νέω νήσω & νύσω, neo, nato. sic in prima specie.
κηΐω vel κηΐω, κηύσω, uro, uram.
κλαίω vel κλαῖω, κλαύσω, fleo, flebo.
Tertia species contractorum habet feré omnia derivata á nomine, & figurativam mutantia. Excipiuntur pauca non derivata á nomine: ut ἀρόω ἀρόῶ, aro, bo. sic ὀμόω juro.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed approximately; accents and breathings in the Greek lines are uncertain. The bottom-right "ÿ" and stains are not text. Show-through and marks at the page edges are left out.
